question: Does this exact head provide an acceptable upgrade path for existing iOS and macOS installations before the approved two-database contract is landed?
rationale: The PR changes durable user state, storage topology, migration behavior, and gateway cleanup; supplied tests and proof are strong, but accepting those migration semantics remains a maintainer responsibility.

options.title: Approve after exact-head validation

options.title: Request a narrower migration audit
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for targeted review of legacy-store discovery and durable-row preservation before accepting the migration boundary.
